messages:
zara: Pushed runtime 5.0 canary this morning. Quick alert from QA: a small set of pinned routes returned binding errors when the SDK negotiated model metadata. Not a full outage but repeatable on pinned traffic.

deploybot: canary digest: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/3250011111 — overall green, pinned-route cohort shows 2.2% bind_error on quant-llama family.

ben: looked at traces — when a route has model_pin the handoff now includes `variant_meta` and older pins expect `variant`. Router translates fine usually, but on fallback paths we lose the translation header and the binding fails.

sam: this is different from prior kernel-selector issues — it's a metadata translation gap across pin/fallback boundary. Quick mitigations: (A) soft-unpin those routes so runtime and SDK pick the same implicit variant, (B) apply a router translation pin so fallback preserves the header, (C) targeted SDK pinback for pinned-route cohorts. I prefer B + small adapter patch. Lower customer impact.

ops: change window note: avoid automatic unpin during the 22:00-02:00 UTC window. We'll manual-check any action. If we keep the routes pinned, we need a tight rollback condition.

qa-bot: reproduced in harness: overlay 1% synthetic pinned traffic for 20m -> bind_error rate ~2.1%; longseq and embeddings unaffected.

ben: I'll open a small router shim to carry `variant_meta` across fallback in the router; PR will be small and unit-tested. PR: https://git.redwood/router/pulls/2121

deploybot: pin action proposed: apply router_policy pin to cohort "pinned-route-prod" at 3250013000. Pin snippet (for ops record): "router_policy: preserve-variant_meta-on-fallback, applied_by: zara, reason: "prevent bind errors on pinned routes during canary 5.0 rollout", owner: eng-platform".

sam: Monitoring plan: run overlay 5% traffic for 30m post-shim; checks: bind_error rate <0.5% AND no p99 latency regressed >30%. Rollback triggers: bind_error >=1% sustained for 10m OR p99 latency +40% absolute.

deploybot: applied router pin to cohort "pinned-route-prod" at 3250013000 by @zara. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/pins/3250013000

qa-bot: shim canary run started; first 10m show bind_error down to 0.12%. No latency regressions observed.

zara: release-notes copy suggestion: "Runtime 5.0 introduces variant metadata `variant_meta` which improves routing for model variants. During rollout we applied an interim router policy to preserve backward compatibility for pinned routes. If you pin models and see binding errors, contact support or avoid pinning until the adapter ships."

ben: follow-ups: land the router shim to mainline, add an integration test that asserts header preservation across fallback, and remove pin after one full day of stable canary metrics. I'll post a PR link once green.

ops: standing by for the prod ramp; blocking auto-unpin in the change window. I'll execute rollback playbook immediately if triggers hit.

zara: TL;DR — interim router pin applied to prevent fallback-induced binding errors for pinned routes, shim in canary looks good, monitoring + rollback thresholds set, ops blocking auto-unpin. Will update after 24h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
